n872b69a9a2.headline: Astana Innovations Challenge brought together nearly 4,000 startups
n872b69a9a2.summary: The Astana Innovations Challenge gathered close to 4,000 startups, with a new platform to support entrepreneurs soon to open in Kazakhstan's capital.
n872b69a9a2.why: Startup support initiatives can boost innovation, economic diversification, and investment opportunities in Kazakhstan.

n5cad74fbc7.headline: Hebrew University opens technology centers abroad
n5cad74fbc7.summary: The Hebrew University has opened technology centers in the USA, China, and Paraguay to promote closer cooperation with local industries and accelerate the application of research results in the economy.
n5cad74fbc7.why: University-industry collaboration centers can enhance innovation commercialization and economic growth by linking academic research with market needs.
